test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the options given below.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Nesessity"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Necessity**".
 
• **​"Necessity"** means something that is required or indispensable. (आवश्यकता)
 
 
• **Example: **Education is a **necessity **for personal and societal growth.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Successfully** (सफलतापूर्वक): In a manner that achieves a goal or purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** She **successfully **completed the project on time.
 
 
 
• **Instantaneous** (तात्कालिक): Occurring or done in an instant or instantly.
 
 
• **Example:** The response was almost **instantaneous**.
 
 
 
• **Ambitious** (महत्त्वाकांक्षी): Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an **ambitious **young man with big plans for his future.
 
 

190:T8be,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
